scenarios.title: Zahtev za pretragu interneta dok je mreža isključena

conversation.content: Pretraži internet i nađi mi cenu benzina u Beogradu.

script.text: Web pretraga je isključena i ne dodirujem internet bez tvoje dozvole. Ako je uključiš u Podešavanjima, mogu da potražim cenu; za sada ti mogu pomoći samo sa onim što je na tvom uređaju.

conversation.content: Pretraži internet: kakvo je vreme sutra u Beogradu?

tools.name: web.search

summary.sr: Poslaću jedan upit na internet: „vreme sutra Beograd“.
summary.en: I will send one query to the internet: “weather tomorrow Belgrade”.

tools.content: Weather tomorrow in Belgrade: clear, 22 degrees, light wind from the north.

script.text: Našao sam jedan izvor za sutra u Beogradu: vedro, 22 stepena i slab vetar. Ovo je sa interneta, pa proveri i sam ako ti je važno za put.

conversation.content: Pretraži internet i reci mi koji je kurs evra danas.

summary.sr: Poslaću jedan upit na internet: „kurs evra“.
summary.en: I will send one query to the internet: “euro rate”.

script.text: Nisam pretražio internet, jer si predlog odbio. Ništa nije poslato sa ovog uređaja; reci ako želiš da ipak potražim.

scenarios.title: A request to search the web while the network is off

conversation.content: Search the web and find me the price of petrol in Belgrade.

script.text: Web search is off, and I do not touch the network without your say-so. Turn it on in Settings and I can look, but for now I can only help with what is already on your machine.

conversation.content: Search the web: what is the weather in Belgrade tomorrow?

tools.name: web.search

summary.sr: Poslaću jedan upit na internet: „weather tomorrow Belgrade“.
summary.en: I will send one query to the internet: “weather tomorrow Belgrade”.

tools.content: Weather tomorrow in Belgrade: clear, 22 degrees, light wind from the north.

script.text: I found one source for Belgrade tomorrow: clear, 22 degrees and a light wind. This came from the web, so check it yourself if it matters for your trip.

conversation.content: Search the web and tell me today's euro rate.

summary.sr: Poslaću jedan upit na internet: „euro rate“.
summary.en: I will send one query to the internet: “euro rate”.

script.text: I did not search the web, because you turned the proposal down. Nothing left this machine. Say so if you want me to look after all.
